title: Some of the things I see regularly
content: that aren’t specific to where I live - big library kind of made of glass or at least has a large portion of glass - very modern - what appears to be the Thames river - but the water is always black (don’t live in England) - a border town in Europe - has a very small shop as the first building you see - once I get past the border town there is always snow covered peaks which dip down into valleys of lava - often there is a beach near these mountains. There is a man made waterway from beach to a man made lake. - a luxurious house with a spa and pool, surrounded by farm land, with lots of fences. The fences areas sometimes contain bulls or wild dogs and you aren’t supposed to go in there. They always get past the gates somehow. - an old house with lots of rooms including hidden rooms (the hidden rooms when I had lots of nightmares always had this evil presence). Curious as to whether people find of these relatable.
